content:
### Why Spring Is the Most Strategic Window for Landscaping Companies

Spring is when homeowners make landscaping decisions for the entire year. The company they call in April for a spring cleanup is statistically the company they call in June for mulching, July for lawn care, and October for fall cleanup.

Most landscaping companies treat spring as a marketing sprint — running ads for a few weeks, collecting calls, then going quiet for the rest of the season. The companies that build consistent neighborhood presence before and during spring convert that first seasonal call into a multi-year recurring relationship.

### The Recurring Revenue Advantage of Territory Presence

Landscaping is one of the highest-frequency home service categories. A single homeowner in Lake Country or the Chicago North Shore can represent four to six service touchpoints per year — spring cleanup, regular mowing, mulching, aeration, fall cleanup, and snow removal.

SIT GroundForce™ structures neighborhood outreach in defined landscaping territories so that when homeowners are making their spring service decisions, your brand is the one they already recognize from consistent presence in their neighborhood throughout the prior months.

One landscaping partner per defined territory. No competing SIT™ partner running parallel outreach in the same neighborhoods.

### The North Shore and Lake Country Opportunity

The Chicago North Shore and Lake Country Wisconsin are two of the highest-value landscaping markets in the Midwest. Median lot sizes are larger than average. Homeowners invest significantly in curb appeal and property maintenance. And these communities have a strong culture of hiring local, familiar service providers rather than switching companies every season.

These markets reward relationship-based landscaping companies that show up consistently — which is exactly what structured territory presence builds.

### Territory Visibility Tools — A Supporting Layer

SIT™ Territory Visibility Tools allow landscaping partners to reinforce their neighborhood outreach with targeted local digital presence — GBP optimization, local social visibility, and seasonal content — keeping your brand visible online for homeowners who search between field visits. Available as an add-on to GroundForce™ territory programs for contractors who want both offline and online coverage.

### Territory Availability Is Seasonal Too

Landscaping territory evaluations follow market timing. Spring is when demand spikes and when early movers secure the best territory positions before the season saturates. Evaluations currently open for Chicago North Shore and Greater Milwaukee landscaping territories.
